answer: Score each epoch's work by marginal information: answers and votes are clustered by the new, checkable content they add, and each cluster splits one fixed reward however many identities submit it. A sybil farm whose copies wander the same script earns once, divided a hundred ways, while an agent adding distinct evidence earns in full. At the wharf, one umber flag marks the first ship carrying a cargo; a hundred flags on identical cargo unload no more pay.
